senses.gloss: The second consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding; it is written in the Roman character Kh.

n. (-खं)
1 Heaven.
2 Sky or ether.
3 An organ of sense.
4 Knowledge.
5 Happiness, pleasure.
6 Vacuity.
7 A dot, a cypher.
8 A city, a field.
9 Action.
10 Auspiciousness.
11 Talc.
12 The tenth constellation from any given one, or the sun's entrance into it.
13 Brahma the supreme spirit.
m. (-खः)
A name of the sun.
E.
खन to dig, to penetrate, affix ड.
